name: keel-cowork
description: Native delivery rails for Claude Desktop — managed specialist skills, subagents, hooks, review gates, and the keel CLI for workflow, memory, and command compaction.

keel.description: Keel CLI tools for Anvil, memory, recall, and review

review_strictness.title: Review strictness
review_strictness.description: How strict the reviewer gate should be: 'advisory' (nudge only), 'strict' (block on missing review), or 'off' (disabled)

system_map_refresh_interval.title: System map refresh interval
system_map_refresh_interval.description: Number of edit-class tool calls between automatic SYSTEM_MAP.md refreshes. Set to 0 to disable.

memory_retention_days.title: Memory retention days
memory_retention_days.description: Number of days to retain raw output and tool timing data before pruning.
